pick.name: Gemini Deep Research (Google AI Pro)
pick.what: Agentic multi-source web research reports with citations, exportable to Google Docs
pick.why: Grounded in Google Search, already paid until Jan 2028, and it does not draw down the Claude Max budget your coding depends on.
pick.free_limits: AI Pro: 4x standard Gemini app limits, one shared compute meter (chat + Deep Research + images + video), refreshes every 5 h up to a weekly cap; no per-day report count published. Older 20 reports/day figure is superseded
pick.maintained: live service (limits page undated; 9to5Google summary updated 25 May 2026)

alts.name: Claude Research (Max)
alts.why: Better when the research must read your Gmail/Drive/Docs connectors or needs sharper reasoning; costs Claude usage.
alts.free_limits: Same limits as Claude chats on Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise; uses limits faster

alts.name: NotebookLM Deep Research
alts.what: Deep Research that lands its sources straight into a notebook
alts.why: Best when the output should become a reusable, source-grounded notebook rather than a one-off report.
alts.free_limits: AI Pro: 20 NotebookLM Deep Research uses/day (per 9to5Google, May 2026)

candidates.name: Claude Research
candidates.verdict: alt: connectors + reasoning, but spends coding budget

candidates.name: NotebookLM Deep Research
candidates.verdict: alt: research straight into a notebook

candidates.name: Perplexity (free/Pro)
candidates.verdict: good fast answers; Pro is an extra subscription you don't need

candidates.name: ChatGPT deep research
candidates.verdict: extra subscription for the same job

candidates.name: Statista / paid analyst reports
candidates.verdict: paid; use only for a fundraising-grade number

decision: Run market sizing as two independent passes (Gemini Deep Research then Claude Research) and reconcile; disagreements show where the TAM number is soft. Lead with Gemini because its quota is separate from Claude Code's.
details: Google switched Gemini app limits to compute-based multipliers around I/O May 2026; per-feature counts are only visible in Settings > Usage limits.

verify.note: Google page: AI Pro limits 4x standard, refresh every 5 hours up to a weekly limit, Deep Research rated high usage; no per-day count published. Matches.
